What was the percentage increase in the sale of Helmets C in 2002 as compared to that in 1999
solution:
**Given:**

Sales of Helmets C in 1999 = 54 thousand

Sales of Helmets C in 2002 = 68 thousand

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = ((New value - Old value) / Old value) × 100

**Calculations:**

Percentage increase = ((68 - 54) / 54) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (14 / 54) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 25.93%

**∴ The percentage increase in the sale of Helmets C is 25.93%.**
